description: Source code for ISC RichTextEditor module, defining classes and functions for rich text editing in SmartClient framework.

classes.name: RichTextCanvas
classes.description: Class for rich text editing canvas, extending Canvas, supporting browser-specific rich text features.

classes.name: RichTextEditor
classes.description: Main rich text editor component, composed of RichTextCanvas and toolbar, providing rich text editing UI.

classes.name: RichTextItem
classes.description: Form item class that uses RichTextEditor as its editing component.

methods.name: supportsRichTextEditing
methods.description: Checks if the current browser supports rich text editing.

methods.name: initWidget
methods.description: Initializes the RichTextCanvas widget, setting up content, overflow, and focus properties.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the current HTML contents of the editor.

methods.name: setContents
methods.description: Sets the HTML contents of the editor.

methods.name: createLink
methods.description: Creates a hyperlink at the current selection.

methods.name: setFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to the editor or its content area.
